reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch hold that Caleb, as head of Judah, expelled Anakim who returned to Hebron after Joshua's earlier rout — two separate events.

sides.snippet: Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
sides.verseText: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill-country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill-country of Judah, and from all the hill-country of Israel: Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

sides.snippet: Caleb drove out there the three sons of Anak
sides.verseText: Caleb drove out there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
